# course-context

> A zero-dependency Node.js CLI, MCP server, HTTP API and browser extension that keeps an AI-readable snapshot of a student's classes, work items, due dates, grades and announcements. Sources: Canvas, Moodle, Google Classroom, Schoology, any iCalendar feed (Brightspace, Blackboard, Sakai, Google Calendar), WeBWorK, Gradescope, custom JSON. Outputs: a Markdown/JSON/iCalendar folder (local, synced cloud folders, rclone, WebDAV, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, git), MCP over stdio and Streamable HTTP, REST with OpenAPI, to-do apps (Todoist, Google Tasks, Microsoft To Do, TickTick, Notion, CalDAV, Apple Reminders, Things), webhooks. Read-only toward schools.

If you are an AI agent asked to install or set this up, follow llms-install.md exactly. If you are answering questions from an existing Course Context folder, read that folder's README-for-AI.md and now.md.

## Start

- [llms-install.md](llms-install.md): install and configure, step by step, for agents
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): working on this repository (layout, commands, conventions)
- [README.md](README.md): the human overview
